title: Rotational spectrum and interstellar detection of the first torsionally excited state of methylamine
question: To experimentally and theoretically study the terahertz and microwave rotational spectra of methylamine and search for its rotational transitions in the first torsionally excited state (v_t = 1) in the interstellar medium toward Sgr B2(N).

recipe.goal: Measure and assign laboratory rotational spectrum of methylamine and fit nuclear quadrupole hyperfine structure
recipe.method: Record absorption spectra from 150 to 1520 GHz using the Lille fast-scan hybrid spectrometer, assign transitions using Loomis-Wood diagrams, and fit hyperfine components to derive hyperfine-free frequencies and quadrupole coupling constants
key_parameters: 1456 hyperfine transitions (including 324 v_t = 1-1 components) fitted to yield 653 hyperfine-free frequencies
assumptions: Perturbation approach for nuclear quadrupole coupling using expectation values from the two-step diagonalization of H_WTR

recipe.goal: Globally fit the torsion-wagging-rotation Hamiltonian and generate spectral line predictions
recipe.method: Two-step diagonalization of the hybrid Hamiltonian matrix using BELGI-hybrid to globally fit microwave, mm/submm, and far-infrared transitions for v_t = 0, 1, 2 up to J = 40, and compute line strengths and hyperfine intensities
key_parameters: 28802 transitions with J <= 40, K <= 17; 79 floated parameters and 8 fixed parameters
assumptions: RAM dipole moment components mu_a = -0.226 D and mu_c = 1.275 D; neglect torsional (alpha) and tunneling (gamma) dependence of dipole moments; nuclear spin statistical weights W_st = 1 for A1, A2, E2 and 3 for B1, B2, E1

recipe.goal: Compute LTE synthetic spectra and identify methylamine v_t = 0 and v_t = 1 lines toward Sgr B2(N1S)
recipe.method: Compute synthetic LTE spectra for CH3NH2 v = 0 (using LSD entry 31802) and v_t = 1 (using new predictions) with Weeds, add contributions of all identified molecules, and compare to the observed ReMoCA spectrum toward Sgr B2(N1S)
key_parameters: theta_s = 2.0'', T_rot = 230 K, N = 1.4e18 cm^-2, F_vib = 1.25, Delta_V = 5.0 km s^-1, V_off = 0.0 km s^-1 (with V_sys = 62 km s^-1)
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE); emission size of 2''; distance of 8.2 kpc; vibrational partition function correction F_vib = 1.25 computed in the harmonic approximation

recipe.goal: Construct population diagram and fit rotational temperature
recipe.method: Correct observed and synthetic populations of v = 0 and v_t = 1 transitions for optical depth, subtract contamination from all other modeled species, and perform a linear fit in linear-logarithmic space
assumptions: Single excitation temperature component across both v = 0 and v_t = 1 torsional states
